initial_receipt.explanation: The downstream result has every priority upstream_rank set to 0 because the evidence_sources handoff uses source IDs as record_id values (s01..s08) while coverage rows use need record IDs (n06-r01..n06-r08). The downstream prioritize function looks up ranks by coverage record_id, so it cannot match any provenance rows. The supplied function evidence localizes this to upstream assemble_provenance, which writes record_id from source_id instead of preserving the demand record_id.
